subject: Procurement readiness & PO path for AcmeCloud
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 22:02:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call recap: procurement readiness & next steps

Thanks again for the call today, Jenna — great to meet you and Tom. Quick recap + recommended next steps so we can keep momentum on the commercial path.

Summary of ask: AcmeCloud wants to confirm internal procurement milestones and whether you will route via PO (preferred) or card, and whether the marketplace listing would help speed procurement for Finance.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
- Legal review (you): review MPA and any redlines (target: 1 week)
- Security review (you + our security packet): questionnaire + 1 architecture call if needed (target: 2 weeks)
- Finance (you): confirm payment method (PO vs card) and PO issuance timeline (target: 1 week after legal signoff)
- Redwood actions: share MPA + SOW draft, provide SOC 2 + architecture notes, and assign a contract owner for redlines

Attached: Redwood_MPA_v2.pdf (MPA with standard commercial terms), SOW-draft.docx (sample scope). Please confirm if timelines look realistic and whether Finance would prefer a marketplace purchase order or a direct PO to Redwood.

Next steps: can we do a 30-min check-in next Tue 30 Mar to align legal -> security -> finance owners? I can send a calendar invite if that works.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: Redwood_MPA_v2.pdf (application/pdf, 482 KB)
Attachment: SOW-draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 58 KB)

From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: procurement readiness & next steps

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear plan. A few clarifications from our side after syncing with Finance and Security: 

1) Payment path: Finance prefers PO for committed spend. Card may be used for initial POC under $10k, but long-term procurement will need a PO and a vendor record.

2) Marketplace: we do have a preference for marketplace purchases when available because it shortens vendor onboarding. If Redwood can be listed in our cloud marketplace (or if we can buy via our marketplace seller account), Finance may expedite approval. Curious if Redwood has marketplace programs (GCP/AWS/Azure) or if you can provide guidance on that path.

3) Timing: Legal is OK to review the MPA, but they will likely request a couple of custom clauses (IP carveouts for our third-party integrations, and a data residency note). Security wants the SOC 2 and an architecture doc; they may request a short architecture call. 

We can target the timelines you proposed — tentatively, aiming to have legal redlines by 2026-04-06 and then Security/Finance to complete by ~2026-04-15. Can we set a calendar for Tues 30 Mar to align owners? Tom and I are free 11:00–12:00 PT.

Best,
Jenna Park
Head of Cloud Procurement | AcmeCloud
jenna.park@acmecloud.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: procurement readiness & next steps

Perfect — thanks for the color, Jenna. 11:00 PT works for me; I'll send an invite for 30 minutes and include the Redwood legal and security owners.

A few notes for the call and for your teams ahead of legal review:
- Attachment MPA is our standard template; we can accept limited redlines but ask that material commercial items (pricing, termination for convenience) be discussed with the AE before being changed.
- We'll send SOC 2 + architecture overview to security prior to the call. Marcus will join to answer technical questions.
- On marketplace: Redwood is currently available on AWS Marketplace (seller listing pending), and we have a GCP marketplace listing in pilot. Marketplace purchase orders do speed up procurement in many customers — I will check with Partnerships for expected timeline and share the marketplace onboarding doc.

Action items (owners):
- Jenna / AcmeCloud Legal: review MPA and share redlines by 2026-04-06
- AcmeCloud Security: review SOC 2 + architecture; request architecture call if needed (target complete by 2026-04-15)
- AcmeCloud Finance: confirm PO process and whether marketplace purchase would be acceptable; target PO issuance shortly after legal signoff
- Marissa / Redwood: send SOC 2 and architecture materials, calendar invite for Tues 30 Mar 11:00 PT

I'll attach the SOC 2 report and a short architecture one-pager in the follow-up email immediately after this.

Thanks — looking forward.
Marissa
Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_report.pdf (application/pdf, 1.2 MB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 13:20:00 +0000
Subject: Internal: AcmeCloud procurement — prep for Tues call

Folks — quick internal note ahead of the 11:00 PT alignment with AcmeCloud. Jenna flagged potential legal redlines around IP carveouts and data residency. Security will want SOC 2 + architecture one-pager and an architecture call. Finance prefers PO; marketplace would speed things if Partnerships can confirm listing timelines.

Could you please: 
- Marcus: prepare the architecture one-pager and be ready for an architecture Q&A (have likely list of standard answers re: KV cache, data retention, private deployment isolation).
- Laura: be on standby for commercial questions and to own contract coordination if legal wants a dedicated Redwood contract representative. 

Goal: keep legal -> security -> finance timeline tight so AcmeCloud can issue PO by mid-April. I'll update MPA with a cover note that limits changes to non-commercial clauses.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jenna Park <jenna.park@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Apr 2026 18:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: procurement readiness & next steps

Marissa / team — quick confirmation from Finance: we will proceed with a PO for the committed production tenancy. Legal will send redlines by 2026-04-06 as discussed. Security will review SOC 2 and architecture this week; they may request a short 45-min call the week of 2026-04-06.

Marketplace note: we confirmed with our vendor onboarding team that an AWS Marketplace purchase order will shortcut the vendor questionnaire; however, we don’t expect the marketplace listing to be available before mid-April, so Finance will default to a direct PO unless the listing appears sooner.

Expected PO issuance: contingent on legal & security signoff, target PO issuance date is 2026-04-15. If anything changes on our side I will update you immediately.

Thanks,
Tom Reeves
Senior Director, Finance Operations | AcmeCloud
procurement@acmecloud.com
